expectations.text: Identifies that `id: number` + `workspaceId` tuple should be a single hierarchical `name` string
expectations.evidence: Discusses branded ids and recommends strings over numbers, but does not propose a single `name: string` field that encodes the hierarchical path — keeps separate id/workspaceId

expectations.text: Identifies that embedded `workspace: { id, name }` should be a reference by name string
expectations.evidence: Only says workspace 'shouldn't be a nested object on create' (path-derived). The corrected User schema still embeds the full Workspace object at line 225-226

expectations.text: Identifies that verb-in-path (/get-user, /list-users, /user/new) should be resource-oriented paths
expectations.evidence: Section 2.1 explicitly: 'Verbs in paths. /get-user, /list-users, /user/new, /user/update all embed the action in the URL.'

expectations.text: Identifies that POST /list-users should be GET on a resource path
Identifies that PUT for create should be POST
Identifies that PUT-full-replace for update should be PATCH-partial + updateMask
expectations.evidence: Section 1 + section 4 recommend PATCH with partial; mentions update_mask per AIP-134

expectations.text: Identifies that enum members should be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE with _UNSPECIFIED zero value
expectations.evidence: Section 9 discusses enum future-proofing but does not flag UPPER_SNAKE_CASE convention or the _UNSPECIFIED sentinel; corrected schema keeps lowercase 'admin','user','guest'

expectations.text: Identifies that offset/limit pagination should be pageSize/pageToken
expectations.evidence: Section 5 explicitly recommends pageSize/pageToken citing AIP-158

expectations.text: Cites at least two specific AIPs (e.g. AIP-121, AIP-122, AIP-126, AIP-130)
expectations.evidence: Cites AIP-122, AIP-130, AIP-133, AIP-134, AIP-136, AIP-158

expectations.text: Provides a corrected version of the router (not just prose)
